prompt:

What leads: a headline "Learn to type properly, one key at a time." with a short line "Short lessons, games and a clear road from your first two keys to fluent typing." and an ultramarine "Get started" button with a secondary "Take a typing test". Beside it, a large on-screen keyboard illustration with the home row keys softly highlighted and F and J marked. Below, three feature blocks: "12 chapters, 125 lessons", "Six games", "Learns your fingers".

Frame: the sqwer wordmark top left, navigation "Learn  Practice  Ranked", "Sign in" at the far right. Clean modern sans-serif throughout, generous spacing, slightly softened corners.
note: Free-plan output carries an OpenArt watermark; small text is garbled by the model.
